meta.name: auto-setup
meta.description: Auto-configure quality gates, hooks, and settings for a new project. Detects project type and sets up appropriate tooling. Use when onboarding a new codebase.

copy.tagline: 自动为新项目配置质量门禁和开发工具
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果每次新建项目都要手动配置一堆工具和规则
copy.tagline_en: Auto-configure quality gates and tooling for new projects
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manually configure tools and rules for every new project

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会自动检测新项目的类型（如 Node.js、Python 等），然后配置代码检查、类型检查、测试和格式化命令，并生成一个设置文件。
howto.when: 当你开始一个新项目、接手一个不熟悉的代码库，或者设置 CI 集成时触发。

say.text: 帮我设置这个新项目的质量门禁。
say.note: Claude 会检测项目类型并配置工具。

say.text: 我刚接手这个代码库，帮我自动配置一下。
say.note: Claude 会识别项目并设置质量门禁。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will automatically detect the type of a new project (e.g., Node.js, Python) and configure linting, type checking, testing, and formatting commands, then generate a settings file.
howto.when_en: Triggered when starting a new project, onboarding an unfamiliar codebase, or setting up CI integration.

say_en.text: Set up quality gates for this new project.
say_en.note: Claude will detect the project type and configure tools.

say_en.text: I just took over this codebase, auto-configure it.
say_en.note: Claude will identify the project and set up quality gates.
